title: Synonym, Antonym, Idiom, and Proverbs — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a proverb: light / many / work / make / hands

visual.text: Many hands make light work.

choices.say: Many hands make light work.

visual.text: Many light hands make work.

choices.say: Many light hands make work.

visual.text: Light hands make many work.

choices.say: Light hands make many work.

visual.text: Many work make light hands.

choices.say: Many work make light hands.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a proverb: the worm / catches / early / bird / the

visual.text: The early bird catches the worm.

choices.say: The early bird catches the worm.

visual.text: The early worm catches the bird.

choices.say: The early worm catches the bird.

visual.text: The bird catches the early worm.

choices.say: The bird catches the early worm.

visual.text: The worm catches the early bird.

choices.say: The worm catches the early bird.

items.reteach: Peribahasa: "The early bird catches the worm".

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a proverb: than words / louder / speak / actions

visual.text: Actions speak louder than words.

choices.say: Actions speak louder than words.

visual.text: Words speak louder than actions.

choices.say: Words speak louder than actions.

visual.text: Actions louder speak than words.

choices.say: Actions louder speak than words.

visual.text: Speak actions louder than words.

choices.say: Speak actions louder than words.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a proverb: indeed / a friend / in need / is / a friend

visual.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

choices.say: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

visual.text: A friend indeed is a friend in need.

choices.say: A friend indeed is a friend in need.

visual.text: A friend is in need a friend indeed.

choices.say: A friend is in need a friend indeed.

visual.text: In need a friend is indeed a friend.

choices.say: In need a friend is indeed a friend.

items.reteach: Peribahasa: "A friend in need is a friend indeed" = sahabat sejati menolong saat kita butuh.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a proverb: in a day / was not / Rome / built

visual.text: Rome was not built in a day.

choices.say: Rome was not built in a day.

visual.text: Rome was built not in a day.

choices.say: Rome was built not in a day.

visual.text: In a day Rome was built not.

choices.say: In a day Rome was built not.

visual.text: Was not Rome built in a day.

choices.say: Was not Rome built in a day.

items.reteach: Peribahasa: "Rome was not built in a day" = hal besar butuh waktu.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: the ice / a funny game / at the camp / broke

visual.text: A funny game broke the ice at the camp.

choices.say: A funny game broke the ice at the camp.

visual.text: The ice broke a funny game at the camp.

choices.say: The ice broke a funny game at the camp.

visual.text: A funny game at the camp the ice broke.

choices.say: A funny game at the camp the ice broke.

visual.text: Broke the ice a funny game at the camp.

choices.say: Broke the ice a funny game at the camp.

items.reteach: Subject (A funny game) + broke the ice + keterangan tempat.

items.prompt: Replace "conclude" with a synonym without changing the meaning: "The meeting will conclude at noon."

visual.text: The meeting will end at noon.

choices.say: The meeting will begin at noon.

visual.text: The meeting will continue at noon.

choices.say: The meeting will continue at noon.

visual.text: The meeting will pause at noon.

choices.say: The meeting will pause at noon.

items.prompt: Change the meaning to the opposite by using an antonym: "The river is shallow here."

visual.text: The river is deep here.

choices.say: The river is deep here.

visual.text: The river is not deep here.

choices.say: The river is not deep here.

visual.text: The river is wide here.

choices.say: The river is wide here.

visual.text: The river is shallower here.

choices.say: The river is shallower here.

items.reteach: Antonim shallow = deep. "Not deep" justru bermakna sama dengan shallow.

items.prompt: Rewrite with an idiom: "Ayu studied very hard for the exam."

visual.text: Ayu hit the books for the exam.

items.prompt: Rewrite without the idiom: "The final exam was a piece of cake."

visual.text: The final exam was very easy.

choices.say: The final exam was very easy.

visual.text: The final exam was delicious.

choices.say: The final exam was delicious.

visual.text: The final exam was very short.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the opposite meaning: "The village is peaceful at night."

visual.text: The village is chaotic at night.

choices.say: The village is chaotic at night.

visual.text: The village is calm at night.

choices.say: The village is calm at night.

visual.text: The village is quiet at night.

choices.say: The village is quiet at night.

visual.text: The village is tranquil at night.

choices.say: The village is tranquil at night.

items.reteach: Peaceful = damai; antonimnya chaotic = kacau. Calm, quiet, tranquil bersinonim dengan peaceful.

items.prompt: Rewrite with an idiom: "Raka told everyone the secret by accident."

visual.text: Raka let the cat out of the bag by accident.

choices.say: Raka let the cat out of the bag by accident.

visual.text: Raka let the dog out of the box by accident.

choices.say: Raka let the dog out of the box by accident.

visual.text: Raka kept the cat in the bag by accident.

choices.say: Raka kept the cat in the bag by accident.

visual.text: Raka put the cat into the bag by accident.

choices.say: Raka put the cat into the bag by accident.

items.reteach: Let the cat out of the bag = membocorkan rahasia.
